description: Ligand-class selectivity of the ARHGAP23 PDZ domain against the screened holdup library, with class I reference domains DLG1 and SNX27 as positive controls
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
from scipy import stats
sets={k:v.split(";") for k,v in pd.read_csv("holdup_bait_partner_sets.csv",index_col=0).iloc[:,0].items()}
txt=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
    params={"query":"(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true)","format":"tsv",
            "fields":"accession,gene_primary,sequence"},timeout=300).text
prot=pd.read_csv(pd.io.common.StringIO(txt),sep="\t").dropna(subset=["Sequence"]); prot.columns=["acc","gene","seq"]
SEQ={str(g).upper():s for g,s in zip(prot.gene,prot.seq) if pd.notna(g)}
def cls(s):
    if s[-1] not in set("VILFAMC"): return "non-canonical P0"
    return "I" if s[-3] in "ST" else "II" if s[-3] in "VILFAMWY" else "III" if s[-3] in "DE" else "atypical"
def frame(names):
    n=[p for p in names if p in SEQ]
    return pd.DataFrame([dict(partner=p,C_term_8=SEQ[p][-8:],P_minus3=SEQ[p][-4],P_minus2=SEQ[p][-3],
                              P0=SEQ[p][-1],ligand_class=cls(SEQ[p])) for p in n])
T={g:frame(v) for g,v in sets.items()}
for g in ("ARHGAP23","ARHGAP21"): T[g].to_csv(f"holdup_binders_{g}.csv",index=False)
lib=frame(sorted(set().union(*[set(v) for v in sets.values()]))); lib.to_csv("holdup_screened_pbm_library.csv",index=False)
print(f"screened PBM library (union of 5 baits, PMID 36115835): {len(lib)} distinct peptides")
print("  composition:",dict(lib.ligand_class.value_counts()))
for g in ["ARHGAP23","ARHGAP21","DLG1","SCRIB","SNX27"]:
    d=T[g]; print(f"  {g:9s} n={len(d):3d}  class I {100*(d.ligand_class=='I').mean():5.1f}%   "
                  f"II {100*(d.ligand_class=='II').mean():4.1f}%   III {100*(d.ligand_class=='III').mean():4.1f}%")
rows=[]
for g in ["ARHGAP23","ARHGAP21","DLG1","SCRIB","SNX27"]:
    d=T[g]
    for c in ["I","II","III"]:
        a=(d.ligand_class==c).sum(); n=len(d); b=(lib.ligand_class==c).sum(); m=len(lib)
        o,p=stats.fisher_exact([[a,n-a],[b,m-b]])
        rows.append(dict(domain=g,ligand_class=c,binders=f"{a}/{n} ({100*a/n:.0f}%)",
                         screened_library=f"{b}/{m} ({100*b/m:.0f}%)",odds_ratio=round(o,2),fisher_p=f"{p:.3g}"))
d=T["ARHGAP23"]; a=d.P_minus3.isin(set("DE")).sum(); n=len(d)
b=lib.P_minus3.isin(set("DE")).sum(); m=len(lib); o,p=stats.fisher_exact([[a,n-a],[b,m-b]])
rows.append(dict(domain="ARHGAP23",ligand_class="D/E at P-3",binders=f"{a}/{n} ({100*a/n:.0f}%)",
                 screened_library=f"{b}/{m} ({100*b/m:.0f}%)",odds_ratio=round(o,2),fisher_p=f"{p:.3g}"))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows); R.to_csv("holdup_class_enrichment_vs_library.csv",index=False)
print("\n=== ligand-class selectivity within the screened library (correct null) ===")
print(R.to_string(index=False))
print("\nARHGAP23 binders, last four residues:", ", ".join(sorted(d.C_term_8.str[-4:])))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
cs=["I","II","III","atypical"]; x=np.arange(len(cs)); w=0.17
series=[("screened library",lib,"#B0B0B0"),("DLG1 PDZ (class I ref)",T["DLG1"],"#4C72B0"),
        ("SNX27 PDZ (class I ref)",T["SNX27"],"#55A868"),("ARHGAP21 PDZ",T["ARHGAP21"],"#C44E52"),
        ("ARHGAP23 PDZ",T["ARHGAP23"],"#DD8452")]
for i,(lab,dd,c) in enumerate(series):
    ax[0].bar(x+(i-2)*w,[100*(dd.ligand_class==k).mean() for k in cs],w,label=f"{lab} (n={len(dd)})",color=c)
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(["class I\nS/T-x-Phi","class II\nPhi-x-Phi","class III\nD/E-x-Phi","atypical"])
ax[0].set_ylabel("% of measured binders"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5); ax[0].set_ylim(0,108)
ax[0].set_title("Holdup assay, PMID 36115835: all 19 measured binders of the\nARHGAP23 PDZ domain carry a class I S/T-x-Phi motif",fontsize=10)
c3,c2=Counter(d.P_minus3),Counter(d.P_minus2)
aas=sorted(set(c3)|set(c2),key=lambda a:-(c3.get(a,0)+c2.get(a,0)))
xx=np.arange(len(aas))
ax[1].bar(xx-0.2,[c3.get(a,0) for a in aas],0.4,color="#4C72B0",label="P-3")
ax[1].bar(xx+0.2,[c2.get(a,0) for a in aas],0.4,color="#DD8452",label="P-2")
ax[1].set_xticks(xx); ax[1].set_xticklabels(aas); ax[1].legend(fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("count among the 19 ARHGAP23 binders"); ax[1].set_xlabel("residue")
ax[1].set_title("Refined consensus [D/E]-[S/T]-x-Phi:\nacidic at P-3, Ser/Thr at P-2",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
